column2: t２６０／戦闘／ケイブリスの不安

column4: ケイブリスとの戦闘中、割り込みイベント　体力が半分になったら
column5: Interruption event during battle with Kayblis: when her health drops to half.

column4: ランス達のシーン、かなりピンチな様子で書いて下さい
column5: Write the scene with Rance and the others in a very desperate situation.

column4: なんとか戦っているが、無茶苦茶強い・・倒せるのか本当に・・・
column5: They are fighting somehow, but she is insanely strong... Can they really defeat her...?

column4: いったん引いて体制を整えた方がとか・・
column5: Maybe they should retreat for a moment and regroup...

column4: 諦めるな、ここで逃げては駄目だ、全てを振り絞って根性で戦え
column5: Don't give up. Don't run away here. Fight desperately with all your strength.

column4: ケイブリスの様子、体力半分ほど減らさせれた。まだまだ余裕なのだが・・
column5: Kayblis' condition: about half her health has been reduced. She still seems confident though...

column4: 内心として焦る、なんだ・・こいつらは、私がこんなに傷付けられたのは何千年ぶりだ・・
column5: Internally, she's panicking. What... are these guys? It's been thousands of years since I've been hurt this much...

column4: もしかして、もしかして、殺されてしまうのか・・
column5: Could it be, could it be, that I'll be killed...?

column4: いや、ありえない、こんな小さな連中に・・だが、万が一・・いや、百分の１ぐらいは・・
column5: No, it's impossible, by such small beings... but, just in case... no, maybe about a one percent chance...

column4: そ、そうだな・・私はいずれ魔王になるんだ、ここでいったん引いて
column5: Y-yeah... I will become the Demon King eventually. I should withdraw for now,

column4: その後、魔王になってから奴らを倒した方が楽だし、安全じゃ無いか・・・
column5: Then, after becoming the Demon King, it would be easier and safer to defeat them...
